description: OpenCompare quality gates. Each command is a single argv (no && || | ;). install/build kept separate. Coverage map for the four single-direction mirror sync behaviours: (1) mirror delete opt-in - deletions start unchecked and only an explicitly checked path is deleted, with the summary, the executable count and Apply reading the same predicate; gates `sync-real-gate` (src/sync-real-gate.test.ts) and `test` (src/renderer/src/views/directorySyncDialog.test.tsx). (2) idempotent dry-run - after a select-all deletion the next dry-run of the same direction lists copy, update and delete all empty, and a repeated round stays empty; gate `sync-real-gate` (src/sync-real-gate.test.ts). (3) mtime and relative structure preserved - every written target keeps the source whole-ms mtime at the same relative path, including CJK / spaces and deep nesting; gate `sync-real-gate` (src/sync-real-gate.test.ts). (4) link mtime alignment - same-target links that differ only in lstat mtime give a positive align count with a runnable Apply, and align to the source, while the dialog and the gate share canApplySyncPreview / syncPreviewAction; gates `sync-real-gate` (src/sync-real-gate.test.ts) and `test` (src/renderer/src/views/directorySyncDialog.test.tsx). Coverage map for the four template placement behaviours, on real external directories only: (5) conflict and overwrite default-unchecked - a conflict, an overwrite and a directory-occupied row start unchecked and only an explicit check writes, and a rescan of written slots reports them as already placed and keeps them unchecked; gate `template-default-unchecked` (src/template-gate-default-unchecked.test.ts). (6) counts and apply read one resolved plan - the executable / rejected partitions of `resolveTemplatePlan` union to exactly the checked set and the real write set equals the executable targets; gate `template-single-source` (src/template-gate-single-source.test.ts). (7) source sha256 and mtimeSec preserved - every written target re-reads to the source bytes and whole-second mtime, and hash / missing / mtime tampering is reported while sub-second drift is not; gate `template-sha-mtime` (src/template-gate-sha-mtime.test.ts). (8) cancel writes nothing - an abandoned preview and a pre-aborted signal leave the full output tree unchanged with no temporary file and no new directory; gate `template-cancel-zero-write` (src/template-gate-cancel-zero-write.test.ts). The full real-directory end-to-end proof (>=1000 template slots, >=1000 scattered sources, Chinese + space paths, four levels deep, dry-run -> explicit selection -> apply -> per-row re-check -> rescan, read-only refusal + retry, directory-occupied and parent-file write failure) is `template-e2e-real` (src/template-e2e-real-directory.test.ts). Release acceptance driver coverage: `verify-release-gate` (src/verify-release-gate.test.ts) pins the single `scripts/verify-release.mjs` implementation - fail-closed A layer (missing / extra / skipped check, sha256 / byte / version mismatch, missing evidence, fixed 15-check registry over identity / mac / linux / windows / cancel-log / evidence), zero heap sampling and zero local 6.4 GiB fixture access in `--layer=ci`, the B layer 16 MiB retained-heap line, and the read-only `.github/workflows/post-release-verify.yml` trigger / permission / artifact shape.
